en.headline: Customs seize about 6kg of cannabis flower at the airport
en.dek: Officers arrested a 49-year-old mainland man who arrived from Bangkok on Sunday, and put the suspected cannabis flower at about HK$1.2 million.
body: Hong Kong Customs said it broke an inbound drug case at Hong Kong International Airport on Sunday, seizing about 6 kilograms of suspected cannabis flower with an estimated street value of about HK$1.2 million.

Officers arrested a 49-year-old mainland man who had flown in from Bangkok that day. Customs said the suspected cannabis flower was found during an airport inquiry, and that his hand luggage later also yielded two boxes of products suspected to be Part 1 poisons and one stick of untaxed cigarette.

The case remains under investigation. Customs said trafficking in a dangerous drug is a serious offence and, on conviction, can bring a fine of up to HK$5 million and life imprisonment. Possession of a Part 1 poison without meeting the legal requirements can bring a fine of up to HK$100,000 and two years in prison.
The department said it would keep selecting higher-risk arrivals for checks, and urged the public not to carry goods for other people without knowing what they are.

zh.headline: 海關機場檢獲約6公斤懷疑大麻花
zh.dek: 海關表示，星期日拘捕一名由曼谷抵港的49歲內地男子，檢獲懷疑大麻花估計市值約120萬元。
body: 香港海關表示，星期日在香港國際機場偵破一宗入境旅客販毒案，檢獲約6公斤懷疑大麻花，估計市值約120萬元。
被捕者是一名49歲內地男旅客，當日由泰國曼谷飛抵本港。海關稱，關員在機場調查期間發現該批懷疑大麻花，其後在他的隨身行李再發現兩盒懷疑屬《藥劑業及毒藥條例》附表第一部毒藥的產品，以及一支未完稅香煙。
案件仍在調查。海關指出，根據《危險藥物條例》，販運危險藥物屬嚴重罪行，一經定罪，最高可被判罰款500萬元及終身監禁。未按規定管有第一部毒藥，最高可被判罰款10萬元及監禁兩年。
海關表示會繼續按風險管理原則，重點抽查來自高風險地區的旅客，並呼籲市民不要在未清楚物品屬性的情況下，代人攜帶物品進出香港。
